waivers.reason: Harness refactor is a small meta-workflow change with focused shell/JSON/static checks rather than a user-facing application requiring 25 comprehensive flows.

features.description: Canonicalize Cutiepie active artifacts under .cutiepie/docs/ with feature_list.json owning feature pass/fail and PLAN.md owning workflow progress only.
steps: Step 1: Run scripts/check-cutiepie-state.sh against a valid scaffold fixture.
Step 2: Verify the valid fixture passes.
Step 3: Add a checked PLAN.md line that duplicates a feature ID and passes state.
Step 4: Verify scripts/check-cutiepie-state.sh rejects the duplicate ownership.
Step 5: Add a checked later-phase PLAN.md line while earlier-phase features are false.
Step 6: Verify scripts/check-cutiepie-state.sh rejects the sequencing violation.

features.description: Refactor lifecycle hooks so session start and update-state use the new canonical state contract.
steps: Step 1: Run bash -n on hooks/session-start and hooks/update-state.
Step 2: Run hooks/update-state with HOME set to a temp directory.
Step 3: Verify STATE_AUDIT.md is written under temp ~/.cutiepie/memory/<slug>/.
Step 4: Verify PREAMBLE.md names .cutiepie/docs/PLAN.md and feature_list.json.
Step 5: Run the SessionStart local contract check.
Step 6: Verify the injected context includes Cutiepie State Contract.

features.description: Refactor core skills to spec-driven development with internal TDD and feature-step completion.
steps: Step 1: Inspect core skill files for stale FRD/CAVEATS active-artifact references.
Step 2: Verify planning skills route through PRD, feature_list, research, architecture, sequencing, and PLAN.
Step 3: Verify implementation skills state that TDD is internal and passes changes only after feature steps pass.
Step 4: Verify scaffold templates create .cutiepie/docs/ artifacts.
Step 5: Run shell syntax and JSON config checks.
Step 6: Run the focused Cutiepie state validator regression test.
